status: предложено (ENV-MAPS P5c UserVariant): NoAI-ассеты только для варианта пользователя (-EnvLayoutVariant=user); технически импортировано после tools/art/env_kit/ue_import_user_fab.py; художественная оценка - только пользователь (агенты кадры с ними не смотрят)
rule: ENV-U14 NoAI: only asset paths and UE technical data (class, bounds, triangles, dependencies, plugins, trace lines); no texture / thumbnail / frame is opened, rendered for an agent, read or described; placed only by Config/ArtBoards/EnvLayouts/<map>.user.layout.json
notes: measured = written by --adopt-report from the UE import report (bounds at scale 1 in UE local cm, pivot = the pack pivot; base = the trunk-foot XY box of a bake). The bakes need no plugin at runtime: the Yoshino tree skeletal meshes are Nanite assemblies (r.Nanite.Foliage / r.Nanite.AllowAssemblies, DynamicWind) - the static bake reproduces the reference pose with the static twig meshes at their Nanite fallback.

M_UserFab_Tree.why: the Megaplants MIs have their parent in the experimental ProceduralVegetationEditor plugin content (MA_Foliage_Trees) and load parent-less without it; this small opaque master takes the pack textures by path (BaseColorMap x Tint -> UserFabNight -> BaseColor), no normal map, no new plugin

MI_UserFab_YoshinoBark.why: trunk / branch bark (material id 0); night muting like the main variant's bark

MI_UserFab_YoshinoBlossom.why: blossom / leaf geometry (material id 1, opaque two-sided like the pack MI override); the night values of the main variant's sakura MI (MI_EnvFab_SakuraLeavesNight: V 0.7, S 0.85, NightTint (0.85, 0.78, 1.25)) - not tuned on frames (NoAI: no agent looks at them)

MI_UserFab_StoneCluster1Wet.why: Sarpedon night: dark wet rock like the main variant's MI_EnvFab_RockWet (P5b: the rocks read too pale). The pack master M_Environment_Basic multiplies its base colour texture by 'Color Tint' only behind the static switch 'Use Color Tint?' (pack MIs: switch off, tint 0) - technical graph data from its T3D text; the value is set blind (NoAI: not tuned on frames)
